picks.episode_title: NBA Coach of the Year + Most Improved Player Award Picks – 10/13/26 (Ep. 1144)
picks.quote: I'll throw it on that. Yeah, I took a flyer on splitter last year, which didn't work out, but I don't regret the bet at all.
